themes_detail.label: Tree branches endangering streets
themes_detail.summary: Overgrown tree and branch complaints spiked to 7 THIS WEEK, up 367% from the 1.5-complaint weekly average over the prior 8 weeks (z-score: 3.89), suggesting either a weather event, delayed maintenance, or rapid deterioration across the district.
evidence: 7 complaints THIS WEEK vs. 1.5 weekly average (8-week baseline)
367% spike with z-score of 3.89 (high statistical significance)
Timing suggests acute trigger: weather, pest damage, or scheduling failure
reporting_angles: Has a recent storm or weather event caused this spike? Check Parks Dept. response logs.
Are street trees being adequately maintained? Review Parks budget and pruning schedules for this district.

themes_detail.label: Noise complaints surge
themes_detail.summary: Noise complaints reached 60 THREE WEEKS AGO, representing a 362% spike above the 13.0-complaint weekly average (z-score: 8.24), indicating a sustained noise disturbance pattern that may still be ongoing.
evidence: 60 complaints 3 weeks ago vs. 13.0 weekly average (362% increase)
Highest z-score in dataset (8.24), indicating highly anomalous event
Top residential concern by volume (958 complaints over 90 days)
reporting_angles: What triggered the spike 3 weeks ago? Was it construction, an event, or a venue opening?
Has noise returned to baseline or remain elevated? Update the data to confirm current status.
Which neighborhoods within Forest Hills/Rego Park are most affected? Map the complaints.

themes_detail.label: Dead animal complaints surge
themes_detail.summary: Dead animal complaints jumped to 7 LAST WEEK, up 600% from the 1.0-complaint weekly average (z-score: 6.93), potentially signaling a sanitation failure, wildlife die-off, or vector control gap.
evidence: 7 complaints last week vs. 1.0 weekly average (600% increase)
Z-score of 6.93 indicates extreme statistical significance
Correlates with elevated rodent complaints (15 complaints 2 weeks ago, up 243%)
reporting_angles: Are dead animals concentrated in one area or scattered across the district? Request 311 location data.
Has a disease or environmental toxin killed wildlife? Contact NYC Parks and DEP for investigation.
Is sanitation pickup failing? Check DSNY records for missed collections in the past 2 weeks.

themes_detail.label: Rodent infestation spike
themes_detail.summary: Rodent complaints reached 15 TWO WEEKS AGO, up 243% from the 4.4-complaint weekly average (z-score: 4.76), reflecting either a broader pest problem or heightened community awareness of existing rodent populations.
evidence: 15 complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 4.4 weekly average (243% increase)
Aligns with dead animal spike (7 complaints last week), suggesting systemic rodent/pest problem
reporting_angles: Are rodents concentrated near commercial areas, residential blocks, or parks? Map the complaints.
Has the city deployed additional rodent abatement resources? Check DOHMH and DCP response.
Are residents aware of poison safety and proper disposal? Frame as public health issue.

themes_detail.label: Air quality complaints
themes_detail.summary: Air quality complaints hit 6 LAST WEEK, up 220% from the 1.9-complaint weekly average (z-score: 4.45), possibly reflecting construction pollution, vehicle emissions, or recent fires/burning in or near the district.
evidence: 6 complaints last week vs. 1.9 weekly average (220% increase)
294 building permits filed in past 90 days (238 alterations) may correlate with dust/pollution
reporting_angles: Is construction dust from the 294 recent building permits contributing to air quality complaints?
Have there been recent fires or illegal burning in the district? Check FDNY incident data.
Are residents near major roads (Queens Boulevard, etc.) experiencing vehicle emissions issues?
